fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Jump infantry carry jump packs that make them the most mobile troops in the DCMS inventory for urban and broken terrain fighting. The ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives these platoons a tactical value that district commanders prize, particularly on heavily built-up garrison worlds where conventional movement is restricted. Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers that fire the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles. At close range, a well-aimed SRM can crack vehicle armor that personal weapons cannot scratch, giving the platoon a meaningful anti-armor capability.
